examples.vi: Ông ấy đã tiêu phần lớn gia tài của mình vào việc cá cược đua ngựa.

senses.vi: môn đua ngựa; trường đua ngựa

senses.definition: a piece of dried peat cut from the ground and burned as fuel.

examples.en: They burned blocks of dry turf to keep the cottage warm in winter.
examples.vi: Họ đốt những tảng than bùn khô để giữ ấm cho ngôi nhà vào mùa đông.

senses.vi: than bùn; bánh than bùn

thesaurus.definition: surface layer of ground containing a mat of grass and grass roots
the territory claimed by a juvenile gang as its own
range of jurisdiction or influence

vi_block: Cuộc đua ngựa; nghề đua ngựa.

wiktionary.gloss: A layer of earth covered with grass; sod.
A piece of such a layer cut from the soil. May be used as sod to make a lawn, dried for peat, stacked to form earthen structures, etc.
A block of peat used as fuel.
A thick, carpet-like bed of algae.

examples: In climates where grass struggles to grow, turf is usually used instead on sports fields.
wiktionary.gloss: A surface of synthetic fibers made to look like grass; artificial turf.
A territory claimed by a gang as their own.
A person's domain or sphere of influence.
A racetrack, hippodrome.
The sport of racing horses.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English turf, torf, from Old English turf (“turf, sod, soil, piece of grass-covered earth, greensward”), from Proto-West Germanic *turb (“turf, peat”), from Proto-Germanic *turbz (“turf, lawn”), from Proto-Indo-European *derbʰ- (“tuft, grass”). Cognates

senses.definition: to force someone to leave a place or dismiss them from an organization.

examples.en: Security guards turfed the troublemakers out of the club.
examples.vi: Nhân viên bảo vệ đã tống cổ những kẻ gây rối ra khỏi câu lạc bộ.

senses.vi: tống cổ; đuổi; sa thải

senses.definition: to cover an area of soil with pieces of grass to make a lawn.

examples.en: We decided to turf the front garden instead of using seeds.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi quyết định trải cỏ cho khu vườn trước nhà thay vì dùng hạt giống.

senses.vi: lát cỏ; phủ cỏ; trải cỏ

thesaurus.definition: cover (the ground) with a surface layer of grass or grass roots

vi_block: Lát bằng tảng đất có cỏ.

wiktionary.gloss: To cover with turf; to create a lawn by laying turfs.
To throw a frisbee well short of its intended target, usually causing it to hit the ground within 10 yards of its release.

examples: Eight managers were turfed after the merger of the two companies.
wiktionary.gloss: To fire from a job or dismiss from a task.

examples: The company turfed the concept car because the prototype performed poorly.
wiktionary.gloss: To cancel a project or product.
To expel, eject, or throw out; to turf out.
To transfer or attempt to transfer (a patient or case); to eschew or avoid responsibility for.

idioms.gloss: Synonym of on the game (“working as a prostitute”).
Synonym of come with the territory.
Synonym of come with the territory.

phrasal_verbs.gloss: To remove or eject from a place.

blocks.etymology: Proto-Indo-European *n̥- From un- + select.

wiktionary.gloss: To cancel a previous selection, especially by removing a mark from a tick box.
To reverse the previous selection of.

blocks.etymology: From west + -ing.
vi_block: Chặng đường đi về phía tây.

wiktionary.gloss: A distance west of a datum line on a map or chart.
A distance travelled westward.
A decision in bad faith to avoid becoming informed about something so as to avoid having to make undesirable decisions that such information might prompt.
